statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is ordered
The service is to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity
The service is to assess for further embolic risk
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed inadequate prior to initiating this level of diagnostic testing
